content: SQL Server deadlock (error 1205) is a normal, expected event under concurrency, not a bug - the standard pattern is catch specifically on SQLSTATE/code 1205, roll back, wait a short randomized backoff, and resubmit the whole transaction (not just the last statement) up to a small retry cap (e.g. 3). Non-deadlock errors should not be retried the same way. This matches SPEC.md's existing plan to catch 1205 and retry up to 3x.
